source: Bell-Pedersen/Dunlap/Loros Genes Dev 1992 (PMID 1459460); Eberle/Russo DNA Seq 1992 (PMID 1472707) -- class I hydrophobin required for the conidial rodlet layer
notes: Confirmed via the 2026-09-23 sordariales_shallow discovery run (Tier P / diamond, real 12-species search): present in all 4 ingroup proteomes (Chaeglob/Neurcras/Podoanse/Sordmacr), ZERO hit in any of the 8 outgroup proteomes. Note: class I hydrophobins are a broad, multi-copy gene family across filamentous Ascomycota generally -- it is THIS specific ortholog/paralog that tested lineage-restricted in the real search, not the hydrophobin domain family as a whole (same situation as pezizo_set1's hex-1 control, whose Woronin-body-gene concept also isn't unique to Pezizomycotina, only the specific ortholog tested that way).
